file: Aria's Realistic Intelligence Assistance 1.0 — Chibi Edition (Chat Completions).json

changes.name: 🌳 README
changes.old: - 🎲 Fate & Chekhov Ledger and ⏰ Time & Place ship OFF to keep the start lean. Switch them on together when your model and context can take it.
changes.new: - 🎲 Fate & Chekhov Ledger and ⏰ Time & Place ship OFF to keep the start lean. Switch Fate on when your model and context can take it; Time & Place is optional next to it, since Chibi's Fate keeps no timed appointments.
changes.why: The README told users to switch Fate and Time on together, the full edition's pairing (its Fate runs appointments on Time's clock). Chibi's Fate has no appointments, and Chibi's own ⏰ Time & Place comment says the line is optional next to Fate. Comment text only, 0 tokens. Chibi TC's README comment has no such sentence; Marinara has no CC README entry.

builder_change_kept.field: impersonation_prompt (top-level CC setting, not a prompt)
builder_change_kept.old: You may disregard the instructions listed in Correct Perspective for now.
builder_change_kept.new: You may disregard the rule against writing {{user}}'s words, deeds, thoughts and knowledge for now.
builder_change_kept.why: Made by the Chibi CC builder (build_chibi_cc.py), verified by the review: Chibi's Main Prompt has no 'Correct Perspective' label, so ARIA's pointer would dangle; the new text names the Main Prompt's rule ('Never write {{user}}'s words, deeds, thoughts or knowledge unless OOC allows'). CC-only: TC has no impersonation_prompt, and Marinara's sections never point at that label.
